decisions.reason: As the flagship digital anamnesis line close to the core dental software and aligned with the digitalisation push, it likely meets aspirations and the firm has slack to keep investing in it.
The continuing education institute supports customer training and loyalty around the core software at low cost, so there is no performance shortfall strong enough to trigger dropping it.
Remote screen-sharing support is integral to efficient customer service, especially after the pandemic, and costs little to maintain.
The analytics dashboard builds on practice data the software already holds and fits the strategy of efficiently managed practices, so it likely meets the aspiration.
The complete practice bundle mainly repackages existing modules for new practices, so it adds sales value with little extra resource use, although bundles are often reorganised.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core and faces strong competitors, making it the most likely target for problemistic search, but it is cheap to run and the independent, profitable firm has slack to carry it a while longer.
